run_vslam_node: run the VisualSLAM ROS node to fetch camera pose and reconstruct 3D world using ORB-SLAM2
get_camera_pose: get the camera pose in the world frame as translation, rotation, and homogeneous matrix
get_camera_trajectory: get the full camera trajectory in the world frame as an array of homogeneous poses
get_base_pose: get the robot base pose in the world frame derived from camera pose and TF transforms
get_3d_map: fetch the 3D point cloud with colors that the robot has seen so far in the world frame
